paite: Lungtang kisakkholna mihing a ahi; himahleh lei dawnna TOUPA a kipan ahi.
Mihing lampi tengteng ama mit ah asiang a; himahleh TOUPA'N khate abuk zel hi.
TOUPA kiang ah na nasepte kemsak inla, huan na ngaihtuahnate hihkip in a-om ding hi.
TOUPA'N thil chiteng aziak nei in abawlta; ahi, gilou nangawn gilou ni a ding in.
Michih lungtang kisathei TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; thei in, gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
Zahngaihna leh thutak in thulimlouhna suksiang ahi; huan TOUPA kihtakna in mite hoih lou a kipan apaimang uhi.
Mihing lampite'n TOUPA asuk lungkim chiang in, amelmate nangawn amah toh kilem in abawl hi.
Diktatna toh tawmchik ahoihzaw, diklouhna toh summuhna thupi sang in.
Mihing lungtang in alampi angaihtuah a; himahleh TOUPA'N akalsuante abawlsak hi.
Kumpipa muk ah Pathian thu a-om; akam in vaihawmnate ah atalek kei ding hi.
Bukna dik leh tehna dik TOUPA a ahi uh; ip gikna tengteng anasep ahi.
Kumpipate a ding in gilou hih kihhuai ahi; laltutphah lah diktatna a hihkip ahi ngal a.
Muk diktatte kumpipate kipahna ahi; huan thudik gente a-it uhi.
Kumpipa thangpaihna sihna sawltakte bang ahi; himahleh mipil in ahih lungdam ding hi.
Kumpipa melvakna ah hinna a-om; huan adeihsakna vuah nanung meipi bang ahi.
Pilna muh dangka-eng sang in nak hoih zawk hi na e; ahi, theihsiamna muh dangka sang a tel zawk ding ahi.
Mitang lamlian hoih lou a kipan a paimang ahi; kuapeuh alampi kem in akha ahawi hi.
Siatna ma ah kisaktheihna apai a, huan lungsim ki-uangsak pukna ma ah.
Gentheite toh lungsim niamkhiak a om ahoihzaw, kisathei toh gallak hawm sang in.
Kuapeuh thu limsak in hoih amu ding; huan kuapeuh TOUPA muang, ama'n nuam asa hi.
Lungtang pil pilvang akichi ding; huan muk khumna in sinsiamna apungsak hi.
Theihsiamna neimi a ding in hinna luikhuk ahi; himahleh mihaite bawlhoihna ahaina uh ahi.
Mipil lungtang in akam ahilh a, huan amuk ah sinsiamna abehlap hi.
Thu kipahhuai khuaizu bang ahi, kha a dia khum, guhte a dia damna.
Mihing a dia dik hileh kilawm lampi a-om, himahleh huai tawpna sihna lampite ahi.
Nasem gimmi ankam limna in amah a ding in asemgim a; agilkialna in huai a kipan alunggulh ngal a.
Mithulim lou in siatna angaihtuah; huan amuk ah meisa bang a-om hi.
Miki-uangsak in kinakna athehzak a; huan huauhatmi in lawm bulte akhenzak hi.
Hiamgammi in a-invengte akhem a, ahoih lou lam lampi ah api.
Kuapeuh amitsik-at in thil hoih lou agel ahi; kuapeuh amuk chih in hoih lou ahon tun nak hi.
Samkang zaw thupina lallukhu ahi, diktatna lampi ah muh ahi.
Kuapeuh heh hak mihat sang in ahoihzaw; huan kuapeuh alungsim thuzoh khopi lak sang in.
Angsung ah ai akisan a; himahleh huai ahihpaisuakna zaw TOUPA a kipan ahi.
